name: task-funnel
description: One-repo delivery funnel plus the scripts that keep it honest

plugins.name: task-funnel
plugins.description: A delivery funnel for one repository task, in three lanes by what the change can break: spec, tests before the code on risky paths, the repo's own gates, a review whose findings are verified before anything is fixed, draft pull request. Configured per repo, so the same funnel runs on any stack.
